description: 市内各駅乗車人数 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 日向市. 統計ひゅうがに掲載している市内各駅乗車人数です。 （データ項目）年次、各駅乗車人数. Coverage: 日向市. The portal files it under the publisher 日向市. Its tags are 乗車人数, 鉄道. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
